stoutford_thief_rumblings20_0.m: Hey kid. A "common friend" told me about you.

stoutford_thief_rumblings20_1.m: Shhh! Quiet here. You helped the guild, so I'll help you too.

stoutford_thief_rumblings20_2.m: A kid that looked like you was here. He apparently did some business with the owner and the regulars.

stoutford_thief_rumblings20_3.m: They were very careful, and even I couldn't catch a glimpse of their deeds, but you should be cautious if you deal with them.
r: Thanks for the advice. I'll take care.
I can handle myself! I don't fear them, or anyone else!

stoutford_thief_rumblings20_4.m: Just sayin'. Do what you will.

rumblings.10: The priest in Stoutford looks scared of me and of what I did, but we never met before. Can this have something to do with Andor?
rumblings.20: The priest's acolyte, Yolgen, told me that Andor was here a while ago, and since then, scary noises resonate in the church, seemingly coming from underground.
rumblings.25: A member of the Thieve's Guild in the tavern of Stoutford told me that the tavern owner dealt with Andor.
rumblings.30: Glasforn, the owner of the tavern of Stoutford, admits to knowing Andor, but evades all my questions by boasting about his beds' quality.
rumblings.50: After sleeping in Glasforn's bed, I woke up in a cave, and was attacked by a monster. I killed it, but I should go see Glasforn again.
rumblings.60: When Glasforn saw me, he was really scared. Hopefully I'll get some information from him.
rumblings.70: I confronted Glasforn. He admited everything, but blamed Andor for it. How can Andor be involved in this?
rumblings.80: Yolgen told me the rumbles have stopped. I should talk to the priest.
rumblings.85: The priest told me the monster was a lich. I should keep its heart safe.
rumblings.90: The priest thanked me for saving his church and asked who the culprit was.
rumblings.100: I told him I do not know who was responsible.
rumblings.103: I told him Glasforn was responsible.
rumblings.106: I told him Andor was responsible.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
